title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Communication Service module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-communicationservice'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-123456', for the purpose of naming resources only 6 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

data_location.description: The location where the Communication service stores its data at rest.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Communication service.

name.description: The Name of the Azure Communication service.

primary_connection_string.description: The primary connection string of the Communication Service.

primary_key.description: The primary key of the Communication Service.

secondary_connection_string.description: The Secondary connection string of the Communication Service.

secondary_key.description: The primary key of the Communication Service.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Communicationservice' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
